Bash(git commit -m "$\(cat <<''EOF''
Fix cross-network relay "join code not found" error \(v778\)

Root cause: Host wasn''t binding to relay until guest joined lobby.
The relay allocation existed but wasn''t "active" until StartHost\(\) was called.
On same-WiFi, timing was favorable. On cross-network, guest''s JoinRelayAsync
fired before host was bound.

Fix: Start host immediately after relay allocation, before sharing join code.
- OnCreateRoomClicked\(\) now calls ConfigureTransportAndStart\(\) right after AllocateRelayAsync\(\)
- NetworkGameBridge spawned immediately after host starts
- 1-second delay before storing join code in lobby \(ensures host is ready\)
- StartGame\(\) host path simplified \(no longer starts host there\)

New flow:
1. Host: AllocateRelay → StartHost\(\) → wait 1s → store join code
2. Guest joins lobby → gets relay code → JoinRelayAsync\(\) → SUCCESS

🤖 Generated with [Claude Code]\(https://claude.com/claude-code\)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
EOF
\)")
